title: Samsara Nutrition Launches Saffron Cashew Protein Bar Ahead Of Diwali
excerpt: The Redwood City brand's fourth flavour pairs Heray Spice saffron with cashew butter for 15g of protein per bar, sold as a $28.98 six-pack gift box
body:
• Samsara Nutrition launched Saffron Cashew, its fourth protein bar flavour, on October 26, 2026, ahead of Diwali, pairing real saffron from Heray Spice with cashew butter and whole milk powder.
  • Each bar has 15g of protein, 6g of fiber and 3g of sugar, according to the company's product page, and contains milk, almond and cashew.
  • For buyers: a six-pack in a Diwali gift box costs $28.98 on samsaranutrition.com, on preorder with shipping by October 30, 2026.
  • The bar joins Spiced Chai, Golden Mango and Masala Peanut in a vegetarian lineup built around South Asian flavours.

Samsara Nutrition, a Redwood City, California-based vegetarian protein bar brand, introduced a Saffron Cashew flavour on October 26, 2026, ahead of Diwali, expanding its lineup to four bars inspired by South Asian flavours and spices.

The new bar combines real saffron, cashew butter and whole milk powder in a soft bar inspired by a classic Indian dessert pairing, according to the launch announcement on Nosh. The cashew butter and whole milk powder base is described as giving the bar a softer texture than the brand's existing flavours, while the saffron provides its distinctive flavour and yellow-gold colour.

What is in the bar

Each Saffron Cashew bar contains 15g of protein and 6g of fiber. The company's own product page lists 3g of sugar per bar and a serving size of one 51g bar, and states that the bar contains milk, almond and cashew, and is not vegan because it contains dairy.

Samsara partnered with Heray Spice, described in the announcement as an Afghan saffron specialist, to source the saffron. The company said it tested several saffron ingredients and flavour options and selected real saffron for its subtle flavour rather than using a saffron natural flavouring. On its product page, Samsara says Heray Spice's saffron comes from Afghanistan, where the company works with a farmers' cooperative in Herat, and that Heray is a Chicago-based company founded by Mohammad Salehi, who grew up in a farming family in Herat.

""Saffron and cashew are a familiar combination in Indian sweets, and we wanted to bring those flavors into a snack people can enjoy every day," said Sravanti Balaji, founder of Samsara Nutrition."

"Saffron and cashew are a familiar combination in Indian sweets, and we wanted to bring those flavors into a snack people can enjoy every day," said Sravanti Balaji, founder of Samsara Nutrition. "Diwali is a fitting time to introduce it, but the appeal goes well beyond the holiday."

Price, packaging and availability

Saffron Cashew is sold as a six-pack in a Diwali gift box for $28.98, with the gift packaging included with every six-pack, according to the product page. It is available for preorder at samsaranutrition.com, with preorder shipping by October 30, 2026. The product page also says the flavour can be added to a customer's own variety box and appears in a separate Diwali gift box alongside Golden Mango and Spiced Chai, while the Classic Trio remains Golden Mango, Spiced Chai and Masala Peanut.

A South Asian pantry approach to protein bars

Saffron Cashew joins Spiced Chai, Golden Mango and Masala Peanut. Samsara describes itself as a vegetarian protein bar brand bringing spices and South Asian flavours to the snack category, putting flavour first and building nutrition into snacks for everyday life. The launch continues that approach rather than following the chocolate and peanut-butter profiles that dominate the protein bar aisle: the flavour is explicitly modelled on the saffron-and-cashew combination familiar from Indian sweets, timed for Diwali gifting but positioned by the founder as an everyday snack beyond the holiday.

For shoppers, the practical checks are the allergens and the format. This is a dairy-containing, tree-nut bar sold direct to consumer in a six-bar gift box at launch, not a single-bar retail product, and preorders ship by October 30. Readers comparing it with Samsara's existing flavours should note the softer texture claim comes from the cashew butter and whole milk powder base, which differs from the brand's other bars.
